summary: Robo.ai Inc., a Dubai-based Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release updating preliminary September revenue exceeding US$100 million and full-year 2026 guidance of approximately US$600 million, largely from acquired QC Capital. The release also notes acquisition-integration progress, Neurovia AI initiatives, and a September 25, 2026 groundbreaking for ALIF Holding's Phase I industrial park. No securities transaction, shareholder action, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated; this is an ordinary operational and revenue update rather than a special situation.
